method: Source-reviewed, not a promise of live behavior. Public documentation and destination pages were reviewed on this date. Account, device and regional behavior was not independently tested. See each entry's limits.

entries.title: Search without AI summaries
entries.summary: Open Google's Web results instead of the overview-filled All tab.
entries.changes: The Web filter shows text-based links without AI Overviews. Your search phrase stays intact.
entries.caveat: This changes this search, not your Google account. It also leaves out rich result panels. Linked pages can still contain AI-generated content. The URL parameter is an implementation detail, not a permanent public API.
steps: Enter your search below and open the prepared results.
If Google returns to All, choose More, then Web above the results.
entries.mechanism: Adds udm=14 to the Google results URL, selecting the documented Web filter without adding words to your query.

sources.title: Google Help: AI Overviews and the Web filter
Independent explanation of the Web URL

entries.keywords: normal results answers overview summaries google web links

entries.title: Use search with AI features switched off
entries.summary: Start on DuckDuckGo's dedicated no-AI address.
entries.changes: DuckDuckGo turns off its AI features and applies its AI-image blocklist by default at this address.
entries.caveat: This is not a guarantee that every linked webpage or picture is human-made. The image blocklist is incomplete.
steps: Enter a search and open DuckDuckGo.
Bookmark the no-AI address for future searches.
entries.mechanism: Uses the official noai.duckduckgo.com subdomain rather than relying on saved cookies.
entries.keywords: search duckduckgo duckassist duck ai alternative

entries.title: Turn off DuckDuckGo's generated answers
entries.summary: Keep your usual DuckDuckGo address and change its AI preferences.
entries.changes: The AI Features settings let you turn down or switch off Search Assist and hide Duck.ai entry points.
entries.caveat: Browser settings may be cleared with cookies. The dedicated no-AI address is easier to reuse on a new browser.
steps: Open Search Settings, then AI Features.
Set AI-assisted answers / Search Assist to Never or Off.
Hide Duck.ai entry points if offered, then save your settings.
entries.mechanism: Changes DuckDuckGo preferences; exact labels may evolve.
entries.keywords: duckduckgo stop assist answers settings

entries.title: See the people you actually follow
entries.summary: Choose Following or Favorites instead of the mixed Home feed.
entries.changes: Following and Favorites show recent posts from selected accounts in chronological order.
entries.caveat: This does not detect AI posts. People you follow can publish generated material. This is an in-app choice and may need to be selected again.
steps: Open Instagram's mobile app.
Tap the Instagram wordmark at the top of Home.
Choose Following, or Favorites for a smaller handpicked group.
entries.mechanism: Uses Instagram's chronological feed views rather than trying to classify content.
entries.keywords: instagram social posts generated recommendations chronological friends

entries.title: Choose a community-led social home
entries.summary: Find a community and build a timeline from people you choose.
entries.changes: Mastodon is a decentralized social platform with chronological home timelines and community moderation.
entries.caveat: Servers have different policies. AI-generated posts are not universally banned, and choosing an account takes more effort than changing a feed.
steps: Read the server descriptions and rules.
Choose a community, create an account, and follow people you want to read.
Use home rather than discovery views for your followed accounts.
entries.mechanism: Replaces the social service rather than filtering an existing platform.
entries.keywords: social community mastodon chronological alternative

entries.title: Choose how your feed is assembled
entries.summary: Use Following or a deliberately chosen custom feed instead of Discover.
entries.changes: Bluesky supports a choice of feeds, rather than a single mandatory recommendation system.
entries.caveat: Custom feeds can themselves use AI. Neither Following nor a custom feed guarantees human-authored posts. Read each feed's description.
steps: Open Bluesky and select Following.
If you need a topic feed, open Feeds and inspect its description before pinning it.
Mute unwanted accounts and words using moderation settings.
entries.mechanism: User-selected feed algorithms and following lists.
entries.keywords: bluesky social algorithm feed discover following

entries.title: Keep the next sentence your own
entries.summary: Switch off Smart Compose suggestions in Google Docs.
entries.changes: Removes Smart Compose suggestions from the document and comments. Smart Reply has a separate preference.
entries.caveat: These are desktop web instructions. Availability varies by language and account. It does not remove all Gemini features or switch off Smart Compose in Sheets.
steps: Open a document on a computer.
Choose Tools, then Preferences.
Clear Show Smart Compose suggestions. Optionally clear Show Smart Reply suggestions.
Confirm with OK.
entries.mechanism: Uses the document editor's writing preferences.

sources.title: Google Docs: Smart Compose and Smart Reply

entries.keywords: docs google write smart compose reply predictions

entries.title: Turn off Copilot in Word
entries.summary: Disable Copilot in supported desktop Word versions using a personal account.
entries.changes: Turns off Copilot capabilities in Word on that device. Excel and PowerPoint have separate controls.
entries.caveat: Not available with work or school accounts, or in Word on web, iOS, or Android. Windows Word needs version 2412+; Mac needs 16.93+. Removing the icon alone does not disable Copilot.
steps: Windows: File > Options > Copilot. Mac: Word > Preferences > Copilot.
Clear Enable Copilot.
Confirm, close Word, and restart it.
entries.mechanism: Microsoft's app-specific Enable Copilot checkbox, not a ribbon customization.

sources.title: Microsoft: turn off Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps

entries.keywords: microsoft office word copilot writing windows mac

entries.title: Stop your keyboard finishing your thoughts
entries.summary: Turn off predictive text while keeping ordinary typing.
entries.changes: Removes the predictive word strip and, where available, inline predictions.
entries.caveat: This is separate from Apple Intelligence and Auto-Correction. Other keyboards and apps may have their own controls.
steps: Open the device Settings app, then General > Keyboard.
Switch Predictive or Predictive Text off.
If present, turn Show Predictions Inline off as well.
entries.mechanism: Device keyboard preferences cannot be changed by a webpage.
entries.keywords: iphone ios ipad keyboard predictive autocomplete typing

entries.title: Use a dedicated, offline writing desk
entries.summary: Write local documents in an open-source desktop office suite.
entries.changes: Moves your writing to a local document editor rather than a cloud assistant interface.
entries.caveat: Installation is required. This is not a promise that extensions or future releases never use AI. Complex Microsoft Office files may need formatting adjustments.
steps: Download LibreOffice from its official site.
Install the version for your operating system.
Open Writer and create or open a document locally.
entries.mechanism: An alternative local application, not a modification to Word or Google Docs.
entries.keywords: offline writer libreoffice office documents productivity

entries.title: See fewer generated images
entries.summary: Search pictures with DuckDuckGo's AI-image filtering already enabled.
entries.changes: The no-AI address filters known AI-image sources using community-maintained blocklists.
entries.caveat: The blocklists are incomplete, not an AI detector. Some generated pictures will remain and some genuine images may be excluded. Check the creator and license.
steps: Enter an image subject and open the prepared Images search.
Check the original source before trusting or reusing an image.

query.label: What would you like to see?

entries.mechanism: Uses noai.duckduckgo.com with the Images tab selected.
entries.keywords: images photos pictures human art generated filter

entries.title: Find images with a traceable source
entries.summary: Look for original photographs, historic art, and documented image sources.
entries.changes: Commons file pages expose authors, sources, dates, and reuse licenses.
entries.caveat: Commons explicitly permits some AI-generated media. It is not a human-only archive. Read the description, author, and source on the individual file.
steps: Search the collection.
Open the file page and inspect its source and authorship.
Follow the license and attribution requirements when reusing it.
entries.mechanism: Searches a provenance-oriented media archive; does not automatically exclude AI.
entries.keywords: commons photograph archive license attribution historic image

entries.title: Check who actually made the thing
entries.short: Shop with a little more context
entries.summary: Look beyond a handmade label and inspect the seller's process.
entries.changes: A short provenance check helps distinguish physical craft, digital downloads, and seller-prompted AI creations.
entries.caveat: Etsy allows disclosed seller-prompted AI creations. Handmade is not an AI-free filter. No guaranteed exclusion operator is recommended.
steps: Read the full description, including AI disclosures and production partners.
Look for process photos, materials, dimensions, and a named maker.
Ask the seller how the item was made if the description is unclear.
entries.mechanism: A manual buying workflow rather than an invented no-AI switch.
entries.keywords: shop shopping etsy handmade products maker craft synthetic

entries.title: Find a product on the maker's own site
entries.summary: Look up a named product without Google's AI Overview panel.
entries.changes: Uses Web results for a brand and product query. Choose the manufacturer's own domain from the results.
entries.caveat: This does not remove ads, certify sellers, or filter AI-written product descriptions. Inspect the domain before buying.
steps: Enter the brand and product model.
Open the maker's official result rather than a sponsored imitation.
Check price, shipping, returns, and product specifications there.
entries.mechanism: The Web filter avoids summary panels; choosing a genuine manufacturer is still up to you.
entries.keywords: shopping brand manufacturer official product recommendations

entries.title: Block Firefox's AI enhancements
entries.short: Give the browser an off switch
entries.summary: Use the AI Controls panel in recent desktop Firefox releases.
entries.changes: The Block AI enhancements setting is designed to block current and future covered AI features and their prompts.
entries.caveat: Requires Firefox 148 or later. This controls the browser, not AI features inside websites. Mozilla's page was available via search-index evidence; the full page required scripts during review.
steps: Update Firefox if AI Controls is missing.
Open the menu, then Settings > AI Controls.
Enable Block AI enhancements, or review the individual feature switches.
entries.mechanism: Firefox's native AI controls. Web links cannot open privileged about: preferences reliably.
entries.keywords: firefox browser ai chatbot tab groups summaries off

entries.title: Read the article, not the surrounding page
entries.summary: Use Reader on supported articles to reduce surrounding distractions.
entries.changes: Reader reformats eligible articles and removes much of the page furniture.
entries.caveat: Not every page supports Reader. It does not determine whether the article was AI-written, and newer Safari versions may offer separate summary controls.
steps: Open an article in Safari.
Open the Page menu beside the address bar.
Choose Show Reader when available. Use the same menu to leave Reader.
entries.mechanism: Safari's article extraction and reading view, not an AI-content filter.
entries.keywords: safari reader reading browser distractions articles

entries.title: Watch the channels you chose
entries.summary: Go directly to your Subscriptions feed instead of Home.
entries.changes: Centers uploads from subscribed channels rather than Home's recommendation mix.
entries.caveat: Sign-in and subscriptions are required. This does not remove Shorts, advertising, or AI-generated videos uploaded by those channels.
steps: Open the Subscriptions feed.
Subscribe to creators you trust and unsubscribe from those you no longer want.
entries.mechanism: Opens YouTube's dedicated feed/subscriptions route.
entries.keywords: youtube video subscriptions recommendations feed shorts

entries.title: Hear the creator's original voice
entries.summary: Switch from an available dubbed track to the original audio.
entries.changes: Plays the selected audio track. Preferred language settings can also prevent some automatic translation.
entries.caveat: Only videos with multiple tracks show Audio track. There is no universal guarantee that the original recording itself is non-synthetic.
steps: Open the video's Settings menu, then Audio track.
Choose the track labelled original or the creator's original language.
In account Settings > Languages > Preferred languages, add languages you understand.
entries.mechanism: Selects an audio track instead of changing video content.

sources.title: YouTube: preferred languages and audio tracks

entries.keywords: youtube dubbing auto dubbed original voice audio video language

entries.title: Build a news feed from your own sources
entries.summary: Follow blogs and news sites with an RSS reader for Apple devices.
entries.changes: Brings articles from chosen feeds into a reader and tracks what you have read.
entries.caveat: For Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Publishers decide what enters their feeds; RSS does not certify human authorship or bypass paywalls.
steps: Install NetNewsWire from the official site or App Store.
Add the feed or website addresses of publishers you want.
Read your subscriptions rather than a suggested-news feed.
entries.mechanism: A subscription-based RSS workflow without a mandatory recommendation feed.
entries.keywords: news rss reading feeds blogs iphone mac netnewswire

entries.title: Read carefully edited classic books
entries.summary: Find volunteer-produced editions of public-domain literature.
entries.changes: Offers carefully formatted, proofread ebooks with documented source editions.
entries.caveat: Public-domain status is based on US law. Check local copyright rules. It is a classic-books collection, not a source for every new title.
steps: Browse or search the library.
Choose an edition and download the format for your reader.
entries.mechanism: A curated, volunteer-edited collection rather than generated book summaries.
entries.keywords: books reading literature ebooks library classics

entries.title: Find the original book, not a summary
entries.summary: Search a volunteer-digitized collection of older literature.
entries.changes: Opens complete ebooks that can be read in a browser or downloaded.
entries.caveat: Copyright status varies outside the United States. Some editions contain historical language or views.
steps: Search by title or author.
Open the book's record and select Read online or an ebook format.
entries.mechanism: Uses Project Gutenberg's native catalogue search.
entries.keywords: books authors original reading gutenberg learning

entries.title: Look up a word without a chatbot
entries.summary: Consult an English definition, then choose a bilingual dictionary if needed.
entries.changes: Opens dictionary entries with senses and usage rather than a generated answer.
entries.caveat: A dictionary is not a whole-document translator. Forum answers are community contributions; context matters.
steps: Enter a word for an English definition.
Use WordReference's dictionary selector for another language pair.
Read examples and forum discussions for the intended sense.
entries.mechanism: Opens a word's English definition URL. Language-pair selection is done on WordReference.
entries.keywords: translate translation dictionary language word definition

entries.title: Translate without a conversational assistant
entries.summary: Use an open-source translation interface with explicit language pairs.
entries.changes: Translates text directly rather than wrapping it in chatbot commentary.
entries.caveat: Machine translation is still automation. Coverage and quality depend on the language pair. Do not treat this as a human translator or use it unreviewed for critical documents.
steps: Choose a supported source and target language.
Paste the text in Apertium and translate.
Review ambiguous wording, especially for important material.
entries.mechanism: A machine-translation tool with a task-focused interface; not an assertion of no machine intelligence.
entries.keywords: translation translate languages apertium machine dictionary

entries.title: Explore a map made by its community
entries.summary: Search a place in a contributor-maintained map.
entries.changes: Opens a conventional map with place search and community geographic data.
entries.caveat: Coverage and freshness vary. This is not a real-time traffic service or a guarantee of route safety. Verify local signs and conditions.
steps: Enter a place or address.
Inspect the map and available directions.
entries.mechanism: Uses OpenStreetMap's native search endpoint.
entries.keywords: map maps directions travel location address

entries.title: Take your maps offline
entries.short: A quieter way to get there
entries.summary: Download regional maps for walking, cycling, or driving without a feed.
entries.changes: A privacy-focused navigation app using OpenStreetMap data with offline map downloads.
entries.caveat: Install the app and download maps before travel. Navigation may ask for location permission in that separate app; ILUD never does. Map accuracy varies.
steps: Install Organic Maps from its official website's store links.
Download your destination's map while online.
Check routes and conditions before setting out.
entries.mechanism: An offline map application, not a Google Maps modification.
entries.keywords: travel maps navigation offline organic hiking cycling

entries.title: Go straight to the forecast
entries.summary: Read forecasts, warnings, and local weather from the US weather service.
entries.changes: Opens the public forecasting site, where you can choose a US place or ZIP code.
entries.caveat: Primarily for the United States and territories. Forecasting uses numerical models and automation; this is a simpler interface, not a claim that no AI exists anywhere in the process.
steps: Open the National Weather Service.
Enter a US city or ZIP code in the local forecast field.
Read active warnings and the forecast timestamp.
entries.mechanism: A direct source for weather information rather than a generated search summary.
entries.keywords: weather rain forecast temperature local warnings

entries.title: Write email without suggested sentences
entries.short: Keep your mail in your voice
entries.summary: Turn Smart Compose's writing suggestions off.
entries.changes: Stops Gmail's predictive sentence suggestions. Personalization and other smart features have separate controls.
entries.caveat: This is not a universal Gemini off switch. Interface paths differ between desktop and Gmail's mobile app.
steps: Desktop: Settings > See all settings > General > Smart Compose.
Choose Writing suggestions off, then save changes.
Gmail mobile: Settings > your account > Smart Compose; turn it off when offered.
entries.mechanism: The Smart Compose preference is account-level according to Google.
entries.keywords: email gmail communication compose smart reply mail

entries.title: Switch off Copilot in Outlook
entries.summary: Use Outlook's Copilot toggle when signed in with a personal Microsoft account.
entries.changes: Disables Copilot for that Outlook account across supported devices.
entries.caveat: Not the same as Word's device setting. Work/school accounts and classic Outlook on Windows are not covered by this personal-account toggle.
steps: Web or new Windows Outlook: Settings > Copilot.
iOS, Android or Mac: Quick Settings > Copilot.
Turn the Turn on Copilot toggle off.
entries.mechanism: Outlook's account-level Copilot preference.
entries.keywords: email mail outlook copilot communication inbox

entries.title: Calculate with visible inputs and explanations
entries.short: Use a calculator, not a chatbot
entries.summary: Find a dedicated calculator for an everyday numerical question.
entries.changes: Use labelled inputs and a topic-specific formula instead of asking a conversational model to calculate.
entries.caveat: This is not a site-wide no-AI claim. Check units, assumptions, and the formula. Financial and health calculators are estimates, not professional advice.
steps: Choose the calculator for your task.
Read its assumptions and enter values in the correct units.
Check the result and explanation before relying on it.
entries.mechanism: A specialized numerical form instead of a generated answer.
entries.keywords: calculator convert units numbers math utility productivity

entries.title: Find a recipe on a source you choose
entries.summary: Search a named baking publisher rather than ask for a generated recipe.
entries.changes: Limits a Google Web search to the recipe section of King Arthur Baking.
entries.caveat: This is source narrowing, not a human-authorship detector or nutrition guarantee. Results still depend on Google's index.
steps: Enter the dish or ingredient.
Open the original recipe and read its notes and measurements.

query.label: What would you like to bake?

entries.mechanism: Combines Google's Web filter with a visible source restriction to kingarthurbaking.com/recipes.
entries.keywords: recipes food baking cooking meal bread

entries.title: Follow references instead of a generated answer
entries.summary: Open an encyclopedia article and follow its cited primary sources.
entries.changes: Gives you an editable article, revision history, discussion, and references.
entries.caveat: Wikipedia is not error-free or guaranteed free of AI-assisted edits. For consequential claims, inspect the cited source and its date.
steps: Search for a topic.
Read the article's warnings and citations.
Follow the primary references for claims that matter.

query.label: What would you like to understand?

entries.mechanism: Uses Wikipedia search rather than a generated summary interface.
entries.keywords: reference learn learning encyclopedia facts wikipedia citations
